method: Exhaustive 729 ordered line outcomes, all 5750 multiplier tickets, and linearity of expectation across five fixed equal-stake lines. All nine grid cells are independent uniform draws.

gambleExpectedReturn.method: One of two equiprobable colors wins 2x; valid amount and attempt limits are outcome-independent.

limitations: This is not SmartSoft probability certification.
Frontend, ledger integration, liability reservation and end-to-end settlement still require verification before release.
